privileged_info_for_vlm: The expected fiducial labels are 'Landmark_A' and 'Landmark_B'. The final exported file must be in .mrb format (Medical Reality Bundle), which typically results in a file size of at least 1,000,000 bytes due to the inclusion of the MRHead volume data.
